title: Scalar-compatible identity pullback comparisons at rational stages
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, a simultaneous coefficient comparison system $S$ [def-fd-pullback-comparison-datum], and its scheme coherence $h_S$ [lem-fd-rational-coefficient-category-comparison]. Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme of finite topological Krull dimension such that $\ell$ is a unit in every stalk. For each finite coefficient subfield $E\subset\Omega$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], let $F_E$ be the recorded rational derived pullback along $\mathrm{id}_X$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. There exist natural isomorphisms $e_E:F_E\cong\mathrm{Id}$ simultaneously compatible with the prescribed common-stage pullback comparisons: for every common-stage object $P=(E,K)$, every finite coefficient subfield $L$ containing $E$, and the inclusion $h:E\leq L$, one has $\beta_{P,L,h}\,e_L(P_L)=T_h(e_E(K))$. Here $T_h$ is the recorded scalar transition, $P_L=T_h(K)$, and $\beta_{P,L,h}:T_h(F_EK)\to F_L(P_L)$ is commonStagePullbackComparison. The pullbacks use the canonical residue-field inverses supplied by stalk invertibility. No separatedness or nonemptiness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Take the natural integral identity isomorphism given by hs at each coefficient stage. Copy the prescribed rational pullback to its literal integral object map. Localize the integral components and inverses. Naturality on a pure tensor is exactly the integral naturality equation tensored with its scalar; tensor induction and additivity give naturality for all rational arrows. Compose with the copy-object isomorphism.

The comparison identification in hs and the scalarSchemeUnit field of the simultaneous realization identify the integral scalar/pullback comparison followed by the target identity unit with scalar extension of the source unit. Pass to rationalization using its normalized pure-tensor scalar-extension formula. The heterogeneous object specifications supply exactly the equality transports at each endpoint.

Conjugate the rational scalar equation by operationStageTransitionIso. Naturality of the rational target unit moves it past the inverse transition comparison. The rational scalar equation replaces the middle two factors. Naturality of the transition comparison moves the source unit through; its inverse cancels. This is the recorded T_h equation. All operations use the canonical fdResidueInvertible instance from stalk invertibility.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentRationalPullbackIdentity
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type v)
    [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    (S : FdCoefficientComparisonSystem.{u} l Ω)
    (hs : FdComparisonSchemeCoherence l Ω S)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X ≤ n)]
    [Fact (∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x))] :
    ∃ e : ∀ E : Index l Ω,
        rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) (𝟙 X) ≅ 𝟭 _,
      ∀ (P : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X)
        (L : Index l Ω) (h : P.stage ≤ L),
        (commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω (𝟙 X) P L h).hom ≫
            (e L).hom.app (P.toStage h) =
          ((stageSystem l Ω X).T h).map ((e P.stage).hom.app P.obj)
